reviews.text: LOVE this Dasique Melting Candy Balm! I bought my first one at the Dasique store in Seongsu Seoul and have repeatedly repurchased here. It’s moisturizing and gives just the best touch of gloss that’s appropriate for professional work environment and not just for going out. Love the applicator—you push the end button a couple of times and the balm is pushed up. The only negative is the length—wish it was a short and fat tube like lipsticks instead of the skinny long tube so it can fit in my pants pockets better. I am not pale white so really pink pinks and peaches don’t work for me. I love the Rose Milk Tea color because it’s really natural looking.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款 Dasique Melting Candy Balm！我第一支係喺首爾聖水洞嘅 Dasique 店買嘅，之後一直喺呢度重複購買。佢好滋潤，帶出啱啱好嘅光澤感，唔單止外出用，返工都適合。我好鍾意塗抹器——撳底部幾下就可以將唇膏推出嚟。唯一嘅缺點係長度——希望佢可以做成短而闊嘅管，似唇膏咁，咁就可以更容易放入褲袋。我唔係好白皙，所以真係好粉嘅粉紅同蜜桃色唔啱我。我好鍾意 Rose Milk Tea 呢個色，因為睇落好自然。

reviews.shade: 03 Rose Milk Tea (+Souffle Color Pot Peach Prim)
reviews.text: I got the combo with the balm and the color pot. The balm is really nice , the color rose milk tea is the perfect nude shade. It's beautiful on the lips. The color pot is amazing too, the texture is very soft and it is very blendable. The color for the pot is light but buildable. I enjoy both very much :)
reviews.zh: 我買咗個組合，有唇膏同色膏。唇膏真係好好，Rose Milk Tea 呢個色係完美嘅裸色。塗喺唇上好靚。色膏都好出色，質地好軟，好易推開。色膏嘅顏色偏淺，但可以疊加。我兩樣都好鍾意 :)

reviews.shade: 05 Sugar Plum (+Souffle Color Pot Orchid Mauve)
reviews.text: Very buttery, melty so don't leave this in your car! I like the color, it's not really one I normally go for as it's more berry and cool tone, but I feel like I end up picking up this shade more than the others that I bought at the same time. You push the product up by clicking the bottom of the lipstick and may take a few clicks to get the product out. I like it, and the orchid mauve pot that came with it is soo pretty.
reviews.zh: 好絲滑，好易融化，所以千萬唔好留喺車入面！我好鍾意呢個色，雖然佢通常唔係我會揀嘅類型，因為佢偏莓果色同冷色調，但係我發現我最後拎多咗呢個色，多過同時買嘅其他色號。你撳底部將產品推出嚟，可能要撳幾下先出到產品。我好鍾意，附送嘅 orchid mauve 色膏都好靚。

reviews.text:
love this color!! its such a MLBB, I do like the SAEM balm more but this one is also pretty. this one is not clear.

I live somewhere where the temperature is above 80 degrees almost every day, and this did melt a bit on me but im very impressed because tarte would melt into a puddle and this stayed solid!!
reviews.zh:
好鍾意呢個色！！超級 MLBB（日常裸唇色），我比較鍾意 SAEM 嗰款唇膏，不過呢款都好靚。呢款唔係透明嘅。

我住嘅地方差唔多每日都超過 80 華氏度。呢款塗喺我身上會融化少少，但係我好驚訝，因為 tarte 嗰款會融成一灘水，而呢款仍然保持固體。

reviews.text: The Melting Candy Balms are one of my favorite products from Dasique. It’s probably most similar to a tinted lip balm, particularly in terms of longevity, although slightly more pigmented and much more glossy. It’s slim form also makes it easy to apply, even on the go. I really like how the colors aren’t too bright nor too dark, making them perfect MLBB shades for me.
reviews.zh: Melting Candy Balm 係我最鍾意嘅 Dasique 產品之一。佢最似有色潤唇膏，尤其係持久度方面，不過發色稍為濃少少，光澤感亦更加強。幼身嘅造型令佢就算外出都容易塗抹。我好鍾意佢嘅顏色唔會太鮮艷又唔會太深，令佢哋啱晒我嘅 MLBB 日常裸唇色。

reviews.text: I've tried almost every melting lip balm on the market and Dasique is one of the best, in my experience. The application is smooth and quick - it does get a little messy on the applicator itself cause the formula is quite soft, but it's nothing drastic. This balm is only very slightly sticky but much less so than rom&nd's. As someone who hates sticky lip products, this one is perfectly fine. The best thing about this product is that it takes care of dry lips beautifully - after wearing this product my lips feel super soft and smooth. Only thing that isn't great about it is that it probably has the weakest persistence of most melting balms I've tried - it rubs off pretty fast so you'll need to reapply it more often than other melting type balms.
reviews.zh: 我試過市面上幾乎所有融化型唇膏，根據我嘅經驗，Dasique 係最好嘅之一。塗抹順滑快捷，但係塗抹器本身會有少少弄得亂糟糟，因為配方比較軟，但唔算嚴重。呢款只係非常輕微黏，比 rom&nd 少得多。我最怕黏嘅唇部產品，呢款我完全接受。呢款產品最好嘅地方係非常滋養乾燥嘅嘴唇——用咗之後唇部好軟滑。唯一嘅缺點係，佢嘅持久力可能係我試過嘅融化型唇膏中最弱嘅——好快就會褪色，所以你需要比其他融化型唇膏更頻密咁補妝。

reviews.text: Make sure to search for multiple swatches as the brand’s swatch is not the most accurate…I was a bit disappointed as I was expecting it to be more muted, but turned out it was not suitable for my light-medium skin tone. This kind if applicator can be messy if you don’t clean the edge after every use.
reviews.zh: 買之前記得搵多啲唔同嘅色卡參考，因為品牌嘅色卡唔係最準確……我有少少失望，因為我以為會更啞色調，但原來唔太啱我嘅淺至中膚色。呢類塗抹器如果每次用完唔清理邊位，就會好亂。

reviews.text: Well it certainly melts!! I’ve tried a few melting balms and this one is probably my least favourite so far.. I think it is too soft that it is just messy on the applicator and lips, it is hard to get a nice even coverage. It also feels really heavy on the lips compared to others I’ve tried. I really want to love it as the colour is so nice and I like the pen-like shape of the applicator.
reviews.zh: 佢真係好易融化！！我試過幾款融化型唇膏，呢款可能係我而家試過最唔鍾意嘅一款……我覺得佢太軟，塗抹器同嘴唇都好易弄得亂糟糟，好難塗到好平均嘅顏色。同我試過嘅其他產品比較，塗喺唇上亦感覺特別厚重。我好想鍾意呢款，因為個色好靚，而且我鍾意塗抹器似筆咁嘅形狀。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
